extraction.agency_name: Office of the Register of Wills

findings.title: Deposit verifications were not performed by personnel independent of the collection process.
findings.description: Deposit verifications were not performed by personnel independent of the collection process. Specifically, the employee who performed the deposit verifications also prepared the deposits and performed the bank reconciliations. As a result, collections could potentially be misappropriated without detection.
findings.recommendation: We recommend that an employee independent of the collection process perform the deposit verification. We advised the Office on accomplishing the necessary separation of duties using existing personnel.

extraction.agency_response_summary: The report states that the Office's response to findings and recommendations is included as an appendix.
extraction.extraction_notes: Report date derived from header 'July 2014'. Agency response content not provided in text excerpt.
